lines.zh: 拖着腐烂的肢体蹒跚前行。
腐肉在腐烂中发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: The flesh hisses as it decays.

lines.zh: 腐肉覆盖的皮肤如潮水般蠕动。
lines.en: Skin, covered in decay, writhes like a tide.

lines.zh: 干瘪的肌肉在行走中断裂。
lines.en: Skinny muscles crackle as it moves.

lines.zh: 腐烂的声音伴着脚步声。
腐肉被风吹得沙沙作响。
lines.en: Decaying flesh rustles in the wind.

lines.zh: 每一步都散发着死亡的气息。
腐烂的肢体在风中颤抖。
lines.en: Decaying limbs tremble in the breeze.

lines.zh: 腐肉在尸骸上缓慢移动。
lines.en: Flesh moves slowly on the corpse.
My knee bends backward as I drag it along.
My ankle shows bone, and still I walk.

lines.zh: 腐肉覆盖的皮肤松弛下垂。
空洞的眼窝盯着过往的一切。
lines.en: Empty eye sockets stare past everything.

lines.zh: 枯萎的嘴唇发出干裂的声音。
我的皮早就烂了，风一吹就晃。
lines.en: My hide rotted long ago; the wind sways it.

lines.zh: 腐烂的气味在周围弥漫。

lines.en: Skin peels off in the wind.
Decaying flesh slides over the corpse.

lines.zh: 空洞的眼窝始终盯着你。
lines.en: Empty eye sockets always stare at you.
Decaying flesh trembles in the wind.

lines.zh: 死死盯着你，仿佛要看穿你的灵魂。
lines.en: Stares intently at you, as if seeing through your soul.

lines.zh: 腐烂的眼球在你身上游移。

lines.en: Empty eye sockets lock onto you.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤蠕动，寻找目标。
lines.en: Decaying skin writhes, seeking a target.
Empty eye sockets fixate on you.

lines.zh: 腐烂的眼球在你身上停留。
腐烂的皮肤在你身上移动。
腐烂的身体在痛苦中颤抖。
lines.en: The rotting flesh trembles in agony.
Sibilant hiss as the wound bleeds.

lines.zh: 骨头嘎吱作响，我受伤了。

lines.en: Green pus seeps from the wound.

lines.zh: 腐肉腐烂，伤口无法愈合。

lines.en: This leg will not drag any further.
The cut has gone black, but I do not stop.
The smell of decay calls to you.

lines.zh: 你手上的血味，把我引过来。
lines.en: The blood on your hand draws me in.
You will always belong to me.
Take it down, let it rot.

lines.zh: 你横在巷子里，我偏要挤。
lines.en: You block the alley, and I shove through anyway.
Neck askew, I bump into you.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就多走一步。
lines.en: You step back half, and I take one more step.
Bump into me and you will carry the stench of death.

lines.zh: 我们的命运交织在一起。

lines.en: We are the same, rot together.

lines.zh: 我需要找点东西填饱肚子。
lines.en: Need to find something to eat.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肉，正是我需要的。
lines.en: Rotten meat, that’s what I need.

lines.zh: 这里的食物看起来不错。
这片土地上有我的猎物。
我要找一个温暖的地方。
我必须找到下一个目标。
lines.en: Need to find the next target.

lines.zh: 我找到了我的下一个目标。
你翻墙的动静，我数着落点。
lines.en: I count the landing points of your wall climb.
Your body heat is calling me.
Dragging my leg, I turn toward you.
Do not run. Let me have one bite.
That wall will not stop hunger.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里只剩咯咯声。
lines.en: Only a gurgle is left in my throat.

lines.zh: 我一步步挪向你的脖子。
lines.en: Step by step I shuffle toward your neck.
You backed into the brick wall; I heard it.
My teeth are already ground sharp.
Once bitten, you will never heal.
No hurry. I do not need to breathe.
Cut off my arm. It changes nothing.
Rot makes me slower, and closer.
By dawn you will be one of me.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩，牙磨到骨头。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder and grind down to bone.

lines.zh: 我的指骨露出来，抓你肩膀。
lines.en: My finger bones show as I claw your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的指骨露出来了，接着吧。
lines.en: My finger bones show; here they come.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这点饿。
lines.en: Your armor cannot hold off this hunger.
My teeth close on nothing but air.

lines.zh: 我伸长手臂，指尖够到你背。
lines.en: I stretch my arm until my fingertips reach your back.
I bite your shoulder. Do not struggle.
This bite will rot down to the bone.
The taste of blood makes me hungrier.
I seize your hair and haul you in!
The flesh comes away still warm.

lines.zh: 从土里扒出来的，还没烂透。
lines.en: Clawed out of the dirt, still not fully rotted.

lines.zh: 跟着我，尸群里还有个位置。
lines.en: Follow me; there is a place in the horde.
So few living left; I choose slowly.
The sixth gait, and still hungry.
I prop myself up out of the ruin.
There is one more rotting body now.

lines.zh: 魔法之力腐蚀我的身体。
虚空之力侵蚀我的灵魂。
